Results.ReviewText:
I'm overall satisfied with my purchase of my E-310. There are just a few minor issues I had with the grill. First, I ordered my Spirit II E-310 from Lowe's and had it shipped to my house because none where available. When I received the package, there were parts of the legs that were bent. The legs resemble a U shape and I guess due to carrier mishandling, some of the legs resembled more of a V. I had to hand bend them back to get screw holes to line up. It annoyed me that I spent a decent amount and there was cosmetic damage to the grill. It is structurally fine now and all the holes lined up but I can still see where a small part was not able to be bent.

The other issue or quirk I run into is the propane cylinder holder. I don't think the spring mechanic works great because I got a full tank (15lbs) and when I mounted the tank in the holder, the measurement didn't move until I pushed down on the mechanism. It sprang back to where it was and was reading as half full. I did it again and then it was reading as 3/4 full. Doesn't really seem accurate to me.

Nothing inhibits the way the grill operates or cooks the food. The surface is large and the food comes out great!
Results.Title: Great grill, minor quirks.

Results.ReviewText:
I have purchased different grills, for less money, and have been dissatisfied with the short life, inaccurate cooking temperatures and the deficient heating elements.  
I have purchased other Weber Grills and been very satisfied with the workmanship and the quality of the grills, but at times, the cost was prohibitive. When necessary, I replaced the inner elements; the Weber site makes ordering parts very easy and the support has always given me backup if I encountered problems.  When the ceramic grates were introduced, exclusively thru Home Depot, I couldn't wait to see how they preformed and I was not dissapointed.  We relocated to Florida and did not bring our old bar-be-que, so when we decided we really missed outdoor cooking, we bought the Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill and have not been disappointed!  The price was excellent (it was on sale at Home Depot and they delivered it, completely assembled) and it is more compact (great for our space), looks nice and has great features.  I'm still learning new ways after 50 years of grilling and I still check the Weber site for new cooking hints and different maintenance tips, but overall, I have been very pleased with this model and definitely would recommend it.  The recipes offered on the Weber are easy to follow and quite tasty, too.
Results.Title: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill - Great Investment

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
